effectOnReadAndLifecycleExceptions.claim: The core filter/group/status/row transforms shown here do not imperatively acquire Git, Forge or SQL. Capture and render lifecycle still have process-local effects.
AtomFamily.value(for:) can allocate an observation slot on first read and records read telemetry; reading RepoCache/PaneActivity keyed values is not literally allocation-free or side-effect-free.
Capture increments counters and resolves/prunes a per-view title memo when live title/CWD/shell inputs change. These are runtime capture/cache effects, not domain persistence or fetch.

Subscription/demand lifecycle can schedule projection/deadline work; native application changes table/selection/visible-target state and publishes visible IDs. A passive row transform and its active presentation lifecycle are different boundaries.
UI interactions persist filter/collapse/preference changes, and explicit editor/open/update commands have effects. They are not reads performed by F04 branch-status calculation.

currentSourceFindings.claim: Architecture Sidebar Data Flow describes configurable Panes Repo/Tab grouping and Name defaults, while current production preferences force Panes Activity grouping, no subgroup, Activity descending and route all Panes through organizedPanesByActivity. Repos still supports Repo/Activity and user-selected Name/Activity order.

Branch fallback differs by evidence: no WorktreeEnrichment produces empty branch display; existing enrichment with empty/whitespace branch produces detached HEAD. Missing data must not be flattened to detached.

Three activity meanings are consumed: filesystem coverage-based repository warm/inactive; settled-output observedAt for Repos Activity grouping/sorting; monotonic terminal/hook occurrence time for current Panes organization/recency. They are not interchangeable.

Pane latestMessageText is captured and copied, but scoped search found no read into the current prepared Pane row variants. Current production row builder uses note,branch,agent/session status and message counts. This does not authorize deleting the field.

Projection request generation/semantic baseline and native lifetime/demand epoch/revision prevent stale binding; they do not assert that all underlying source facts share one fresh repository revision.

gaps: This is a bounded current RepoExplorer/sidebar consumer walk, not an exhaustive whole-UI or all-popover census. Sixteen grouped prepared families are named; declared fallback/legacy variants are identified separately from traced production emission.

Full command-capability batch internals, every native update-plan algorithm, all keyboard/context-menu journeys, actual window/timezone notifications and full PaneContext popover detail loading were not independently traced.
Upstream Git/remote/Forge acquisition and topology persistence reuse the unchanged prior seven-family evidence and same-session decisive sources. No new full SDK/Forge pipeline audit was performed.
PaneActivityClock declaration/terminal submission and durable record shape were inspected; the full hook producer and production wall-time persistence sink were not retraced in this pass.
No runtime, tests/builds/probes, native table/pixel proof, performance measurement, network/credentials, cross-process replication or future Gateway/Host behavior was observed or selected.
